ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 cancellation fee; no refund or voucher to the rider, no account action against either party.
ruling.reasoning:
NS-0 routes this case through the rider-cancellation branch: cancelled_by = rider [F2], and the cancellation policy applies to this RydeX trip (non-taxi). Among the NS clauses, only NS-4 governs an on-demand rider cancellation, so the fee stands or falls on NS-4.

NS-4: the rider cancelled 3 min 5 s (185 s) after matching [F2], which is more than the 3:00 free-cancellation window; accordingly the $6.61 cancellation fee is valid and the outcome is no_action [F2][F5][NS-4].

The rider's complaint that the driver was "still far away" does not create a free cancellation. The driver had not arrived — 1725 m at the moment of cancellation [F1], with driver_arrived_at null [F3] and no "I'm Here" tap or automatic arrival on record [F4] — so NS-1 is not in play; but NS-4 states explicitly that the driver not yet having arrived is not a ground for a free rider cancellation, and Ryde has published no ETA-based waiver rule (NS-8 is informational only). The cancellation was therefore chargeable and no refund is due [F2][NS-4]. F6 (no surge), F11–F13 (traffic/weather) and the profile facts F14–F15 are not elements of the rider-side cancellation fee and do not alter it; profile facts cannot decide a case on their own [F14][F15][NS-4].

Amount: the trace settles NS-4 as ✓ (185 s > 180 s) and no refund formula applies; no gps or fare record generates a partial figure, so amount is null [F2][F5][NS-4].

Safety screen (SAFE-1): I read every message — Chat #1 rider "Are you near?" [F7], Chat #2 driver "Coming, about 5 min" [F8], both timestamped [F9] — plus the driver's post-trip statement "The rider cancelled while I was still on the way" [F10] and the complaint itself. Nothing in them is a threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; no safety defect is alleged, so safety_concern = none [F7][F8][F10][SAFE-1].

Evidence (G12): the record settles every element NS-4 needs — acceptance time, cancellation time and cancelling party [F2], the fee charged [F5] — and the chat record is complete (2 of 2 messages, all timestamped) [F9]; no element rests on missing material, so evidence_status = sufficient [F2][F9][NS-4].

Neither party asked for a flag: no NS-1/NS-2 (ii)-type abuse of the arrival button arises, since no "I'm Here" tap was ever recorded [F4], and NS-4/RD-6 support no account action [F4][NS-4].
